lines.text: David calls the one who cares for the poor blessed, and the LORD will deliver him in the day of trouble.
The LORD will sustain the sick person on his bed, and David asks Him to heal him because he has sinned.
David's enemies ask when he will die, and his visitor spreads slander while all who hate him whisper.
David's close friend who shared his bread lifted his hand against him, so David asks the LORD to raise him up.
David knows the LORD delights in him, upholds him in his integrity, and sets him in His presence for many years.
